findings.why_relevant: Aminx emits q=21 logits (num_amino_acids=21), NOT q=20 as Q1 premise states. Real issue is 21-vs-21 semantic mismatch.
aminx token 20 = X (unknown), Potts token 20 = gap. Semantic collision at index 20, not a length mismatch.
k_neighbors is a static field set at skeleton construction from topology; changing k changes pytree -> k is baked into checkpoint. Confirms Q2 real constraint.
topology (incl k) inferred from checkpoint_id string at load; skeleton must match weight file. Confirms checkpoint-versioning coupling for Q2.
existing multistate combine already requires homogeneous stacked leading axis (jnp.mean axis=0). Grounds Q4 homogeneity-is-already-the-norm finding.

verdict: Approach A+D architecturally sound. Q1 premise factually wrong (q=21 both sides, semantic collision at idx20). Q2 real material constraint. Q4 already the established pattern. Q3/Q5/Q6 evidence-limited (mistypotts external).

issues.description: Q1 premise wrong: aminx is q=21 (VOCAB_SIZE=21 in weights.py:28, num_amino_acids=21 in mpnn.py:52). Real risk is semantic collision at index 20: aminx idx20=X (unknown) vs Potts idx20=gap. Resolution: explicit static alphabet_map (length-21 permutation) + idx20-semantics load-time assertion in MpnnPottsDesigner. Also verify Potts idx 0-19 ordering matches MPNN_ALPHABET[0:19] before finalizing.

Q2: k is baked into checkpoint (edge feature dim depends on k, confirmed by features.py:76 and weights.py:202,219). k must be read-only derived from checkpoint metadata in PottsRunSpec, never independently settable.

Q6: fori_loop TRW backend materializes all intermediate message states under reverse-mode autodiff. OOM risk for training. Enforce scan+checkpoint_trw_step backend for training specs at spec construction time (fail loudly, not at cluster OOM time).

Q5/Q3: caliby_path as required field creates hidden critical-path dependency on cluster-only dataset. Fix: make caliby_path optional in PottsRunSpec; identity correction (zero bias) as default. Breaks P-02->P-08 blocking edge.

Unlisted: MpnnPottsDesigner seeds Gibbs from order-dependent AR MPNN logits, not true marginals. Seeding inherits decoding order bias. Decision required: seed from unconditional per-position logits or order-averaged estimate. Record as explicit decision before P-10.
Unlisted: log_prob(seq, backbone)->float interface needs batch axis convention specified now (vmap over backbones? over sequences? both?) to avoid inconsistent retrofitting.

Unlisted: PottsModel weight-loading should reuse existing load_weights zstd/skeleton machinery (weights.py:102-148) rather than fork it.

Approach A+D (parallel PottsModel) CONFIRMED by arch-advisor. Options II (decode_step adapter), III (EncoderOutput widening), IV (PoE via ProductOfProbabilities) all rejected as YAGNI violations and semantic mismatches.
EncoderOutput (bundles.py:359) must NOT be touched. Its four MPNN fields are load-bearing across the entire inference stack. Widening for Potts is the highest-blast-radius mistake available.

Import boundary must be enforced mechanically: aminx.potts.{model,poe,sampling} may NOT import from aminx.inference.decode, aminx.host.plan, aminx.types.stages, aminx.inference.logits. Only aminx.potts.designer is exempt. Needs an ast-grep / import-lint guardrail item.
Run loop methods should be renamed: infer_params / sample / score (not encode/decode/sample/score) to avoid implying InferencePlan interchangeability. Update P-08 description.
PoE sanity measurement needed (BATHOS rule): for identical backbones assert E_poe(seq) == 2 * E_single(seq) within tolerance; verify x2 h/J scale survives the PoE sum. Add as backlog item.
ADR required: lock 'Potts is a parallel model family, NOT a StageSet consumer' so future contributors don't wire it into decode_step. Add as backlog item.
